note: The appropriation calendar for DoD, FY2021-FY2026. Every row cites the public law or CRS product that states it. Day counts are NOT stored here: they are derived in SQL from these dates, so the arithmetic cannot drift away from the dates it is drawn from. 'basis' follows the /nfr convention: reported means the cited document states it, derived means this site read it out of the record.

dm_approp_event.title: Department operating under continuing appropriations
dm_approp_event.note: The span from the start of the fiscal year to the day before the full-year act took effect. Derived from the two dates below.

dm_approp_event.title: Continuing Appropriations Act, 2021
dm_approp_event.note: The opening continuing resolution. Short extensions ran from 11 December to enactment and are not itemised individually here.

dm_approp_event.title: Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2021 (Division C: Department of Defense)
dm_approp_event.note: Full-year Department of Defense appropriations, signed 27 December 2020.

dm_approp_event.title: Department operating under continuing appropriations
Extending Government Funding and Delivering Emergency Assistance Act
Further Extending Government Funding Act
Further Additional Extending Government Funding Act
dm_approp_event.note: A final short extension carried the Department to 15 March.

dm_approp_event.title: Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2022 (Division C: Department of Defense)
dm_approp_event.note: Full-year Department of Defense appropriations, signed 15 March 2022 -- 165 days into the fiscal year.

dm_approp_event.title: Department operating under continuing appropriations
Continuing Appropriations and Ukraine Supplemental Appropriations Act, 2023
Further Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2023
Further Additional Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2023
dm_approp_event.note: Superseded for the Department by the full-year act signed 29 December.

dm_approp_event.title: Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2023 (Division C: Department of Defense)
dm_approp_event.note: Full-year Department of Defense appropriations, signed 29 December 2022.

dm_approp_event.title: Department operating under continuing appropriations
Continuing Appropriations Act, 2024 and Other Extensions Act
Further Continuing Appropriations and Other Extensions Act, 2024
dm_approp_event.note: The laddered continuing resolution: two expiry dates, 19 January and 2 February. Defense sat in the later tranche, so 2 February is the date that applied to this Department.

dm_approp_event.title: Further Additional Continuing Appropriations and Other Extensions Act, 2024
dm_approp_event.note: Laddered again, 1 March and 8 March. Defense in the later tranche.

dm_approp_event.title: Extension of Continuing Appropriations and Other Matters Act, 2024
dm_approp_event.note: Defense in the 22 March tranche. P.L. 118-42 of 9 March carried six other bills to full-year enactment and did not include Defense.

dm_approp_event.title: Further Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2024 (Division A: Department of Defense)
dm_approp_event.note: Full-year Department of Defense appropriations, signed 23 March 2024 -- 174 days into the fiscal year, the longest continuing-resolution period of the six years here bar the full-year CR that followed it.

dm_approp_event.title: Full-Year Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2025
dm_approp_event.note: FY2025 never received a Department of Defense Appropriations Act. The Department operated on continuing appropriations for all 365 days, with anomalies rather than a new appropriation structure. This is the only year of the six in that position and no other year's execution shape is comparable to it.

dm_approp_event.title: Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2025
American Relief Act, 2025
Full-Year Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2025
dm_approp_event.note: Carried the Department to the end of the fiscal year on continuing appropriations.

dm_approp_event.title: Lapse in appropriations
dm_approp_event.note: The longest lapse in appropriations on record. No appropriation of any kind was in force for the Department from the first day of the fiscal year until 12 November.

dm_approp_event.title: Continuing Appropriations, Agriculture, Legislative Branch, Military Construction and Veterans Affairs, and Extensions Act, 2026
dm_approp_event.note: Ended the lapse and carried the Department on continuing appropriations to 30 January. Military Construction and Veterans Affairs received full-year appropriations in the same act; the rest of the Department did not.

dm_approp_event.title: Lapse in appropriations
dm_approp_event.note: A second, short lapse between the expiry of P.L. 119-37 and the full-year act.

dm_approp_event.title: Department without full-year appropriations
dm_approp_event.note: The whole span before the full-year act, of which 46 days were a lapse rather than a continuing resolution. The two are not the same state and the page does not merge them.

dm_approp_event.title: Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026 (Division A: Department of Defense)
dm_approp_event.note: Full-year Department of Defense appropriations, signed 3 February 2026. CRS states $839.2B in FY2026 discretionary appropriations for the Department under this act, $8.4B above the request for activities it covers.
